# `approx_top_k`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
approx_top_k(expr, k, maxItemsTracked)
```

Returns top k items with their frequency.
`k` An optional INTEGER literal greater than 0. If k is not specified, it defaults to 5.
`maxItemsTracked` An optional INTEGER literal greater than or equal to k and has upper limit of 1000000. If maxItemsTracked is not specified, it defaults to 10000.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2, 3] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- approx_top_k, example 1
> SELECT approx_top_k(expr) FROM VALUES (0), (0), (1), (1), (2), (3), (4), (4) AS tab(expr);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```

```sql
-- approx_top_k, example 2
> SELECT approx_top_k(expr, 2) FROM VALUES 'a', 'b', 'c', 'c', 'c', 'c', 'd', 'd' AS tab(expr);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```

```sql
-- approx_top_k, example 3
> SELECT approx_top_k(expr, 10, 100) FROM VALUES (0), (1), (1), (2), (2), (2) AS tab(expr);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```
